title: The Trash Villainess Has Returned
alternativeTitles: 망나니 악녀가 돌아왔다 / The Baddest Villainess Is Back
description:
I was sentenced to death and died.

"It's a bit of a waste to let you die as a villainess." "How about it? I would like to give you a chance."

No, I thought I had died. But was it because of what that enemy-like bastard said right before my death?

'Geron, you son of a b*tch...!'

When I opened my eyes, I had regressed 10 years into the past. And into a different world, at that!

Since I've been brought back to life anyway, it can't be helped. To make sure I don't repeat my foolish past...

"I'll take everything from here to there." "...Are you saying you're going to buy all of this?"

I stuck a straw into that enemy-like bastard and used him as my personal wallet.

"Well, my friends brag that their granddaughters act affectionately and ask to go shopping with them." "That's just because they need a wallet." "……."

"Father, I have a banquet to attend. Could you escort me?" "……Of course. But are you sure you're okay with it being me?" "Yes. As long as you do something about that gloomy appearance of yours."

I brilliantly restored my severely ruined family relationships.

"...If I tell you that I like you, would that put you in an awkward position, Roselyne?" "Then shall we try dating for just half a year?" "……Pardon?"

I even perfectly kickstarted the romance I had once given up on. It was the perfect future I had hoped for, but...

"Rose, you have the Abyss too."

It turns out that I, who thought I was powerless, actually have an ability. And that ability is...
